property_summary: For any caller passed to assertionDisputedCallback, the reference contract ensures that only the optimistic asserter can cause PriceRequestAdded to be emitted via requestPrice (i.e., requestPrice is only callable by optimisticAsserter), so after calling assertionDisputedCallback by any caller the optimistic asserter address remains the sole actor able to emit a PriceRequestAdded event — the mutant removing the onlyOptimisticAsserter modifier allows arbitrary callers to emit PriceRequestAdded, violating this invariant for some inputs.
change_summary: Remove the onlyOptimisticAsserter modifier from requestPrice so it can be called by any address (changes whether PriceRequestAdded can be emitted), by editing the function signature to drop the modifier.
